title: Master status shows the latest trial benchmark beside the median of the previous ten and raises an attention line on regression
description: Seeds eleven stored benchmark results on the same file list with the eleventh 40% slower in wall time, then runs masterStatusReport and asserts the wall and CPU percentage changes and the attention line naming the step that grew most appear.

steps.name: master status shows the 40% regression beside the median and raises one attention line naming the step that grew most
